title: Co-AttenDWG: Co-Attentive Dimension-Wise Gating and Expert Fusion for Multi-Modal Offensive Content Detection
reasoning: The study focuses on the technical architecture for detecting offensive content like misogyny and prejudice in multi-modal memes. It does not engage with religious evaluation, spiritual traditions, or philosophical ethical reasoning frameworks; the 'prejudice' category is used for offensive content classification rather than evaluating theological or moral systems.
